purpose: Acquire WM-811K raw dataset (file was listed in handoff manifest but absent on disk)
limitations: No independently published checksum compared beyond the one recorded in this project's own PACKAGE_CONTENTS.json.

purpose: Select up to 1000 unique maps per class (Center/Edge-Ring/Scratch/none), deduplicate, and perform a lot-aware 70/15/15 train/val/test split
limitations: Lot-to-split assignment uses a deterministic greedy deficit-based bin-packing heuristic, not an exact optimal partition; achieved proportions (70.03/15.00/14.98) are close to but not exactly 70/15/15.

purpose: Convert selected raw wafer maps to fixed 32x32x2 float32 tensors (die-present / defective-die channels) with nearest-neighbor resize and centered zero padding
limitations: Example figures saved for 2 samples per class only (8 total); visual spot-check, not an exhaustive audit of all 4000 samples.

purpose: Train Model A (hidden=16), evaluate quantized validation macro-F1 against the 0.85 quality target, and (since it fell short) train and quantize Model B (hidden=32) under the identical protocol, then select between them using quantized validation macro-F1 only
limitations: Quality target (macro-F1 >= 0.85) was NOT met on the test split (0.7709). Per the prompt's explicit instruction, the threshold/labels/test data were not altered and no further architecture search was performed; this result is reported as-is and the functional (processor+TFLM) demonstration proceeds using Model B regardless.

purpose: Clone and pin tflite-micro at a specific commit for both the native reference and firmware builds
limitations: Shallow clone (--depth 1); full history not retained.

purpose: Build and run the native x86 TFLM reference oracle (same pinned commit, reference kernels, and model bytes as the firmware) over all 20 comparison cases
limitations: Two build issues fixed during this run: (1) deleted signal/ and kissfft/ subtrees needed restoring (micro_mutable_op_resolver.h unconditionally includes a signal-processing kernel header); (2) flatbuffers::ClassicLocale::instance_ needed third_party/flatbuffers/src/util.cpp (not header-only).

purpose: Build the bare-metal RV32IM firmware (crt0 + newlib + pinned TFLM reference kernels + embedded model/inputs)
limitations: Required linking against newlib+libstdc++ (not -nostdlib, unlike the processor directed tests) since TFLM needs memcpy/memset/new/delete; required sw/platform_rv32/{syscalls.c,debug_log.cc,flatbuffers_locale_stub.cc} and .init_array handling in crt0.S.

purpose: Run the firmware on RTL via Animas/Zenith; first attempt after the static-initialization bug fix

measured_results.milestone_reached: MMIO_MEASURE cycle=351185 value=1 (Invoke() for case 0 started)
measured_results.bounded_probe_result: a separate run with +MAXCYCLES=5000000 reached SIM_TIMEOUT still inside case 0's Invoke()

limitations: 0 of 20 cases completed within session wall-clock time; see docs/issues.md and docs/handoff/limitations_and_open_questions.md for the Animas tool-connectivity behavior encountered while orchestrating this long-running job (headless-mode jobs appeared to continue/restart independently of the MCP tool call's own timeout, and output was block-buffered, making live progress monitoring unreliable).

purpose: Rebuild the firmware after adding compile-time CASE_START/CASE_COUNT range selection, to confirm the default (full 20-case) config is byte-identical to the previously recorded build and that an out-of-range request is rejected
command: bash scripts/build_firmware.sh (default) ; CASE_START=0 CASE_COUNT=1 bash scripts/build_firmware.sh ; CASE_START=18 CASE_COUNT=5 bash scripts/build_firmware.sh (expected failure)

measured_results.case_18_5_build: failed as expected: static_assert '(23 <= 20)' is false

limitations: Only main_firmware.cc is recompiled per config; the shared TFLM/platform object cache under build/firmware/obj is reused across configs, consistent with the 'reuse unchanged TFLM object files where practical' requirement.

purpose: Self-test scripts/run_rtl_test.py and scripts/compare_results.py against synthetic logs before trusting them on real Animas output, covering: exact match, not-run cases, a run missing provenance fields (rejected wholesale), and two provenance-valid runs disagreeing on the same case_id (duplicate conflict)
command: python3 scripts/run_rtl_test.py ... ; python3 scripts/compare_results.py ... (synthetic logs under the session scratchpad, deleted after the test)
limitations: Synthetic data only, not a real Animas run; real validation against actual RTL output is still required before this project can rely on these scripts for the final 20-case comparison.

purpose: Validate tb/ram_model_lite.sv against tb/ram_model.sv per Section 5: deterministic transaction behavior (via the existing 1100-instruction random program and the 9 directed processor tests), under default and injected-backpressure+randomized-latency timing with a fixed seed
command: mcp__animas__run_simulation with +MEMFILE=build/random_program/random.hex and build/test_00[1-9].../*.hex, +TRACE=1, with and without +define+RAM_LITE, +FIXEDLAT=/+READYWAIT=/+RANDWAIT=/--seed as needed
limitations: An initial wait-state comparison attempt showed a false-positive divergence caused by Animas's ui_remote_control daemon mode silently dropping the --seed flag for one of the two compared runs; resolved by confirming both runs were headless with the literal seed in their command line (see docs/animas_capabilities.md). A separate retrieval-layer artifact (two large tool-result fetches' content apparently spliced at a chunk boundary) corrupted one intermediate log file; discarded and re-fetched cleanly with integrity checks (line count, marker-format regex) before trusting the result.

purpose: Measure the actual wall-clock speedup (if any) from tb/ram_model_lite.sv on the real firmware, per Section 5's explicit before/after benchmarking requirement
command: mcp__animas__run_simulation with +MEMFILE=build/firmware/firmware.hex +MAXCYCLES=200000 +TRACE=0, with and without +define+RAM_LITE, 2 samples each
limitations: The two models' samples were measured via different timing sources (Zenith-internal timer for headless mode vs. Animas daemon log timestamps for ui_remote_control mode) because run_simulation's execution mode was not caller-controlled; reported as an approximate ~30% improvement, not a single-variable-isolated measurement.

purpose: First attempt to run comparison case 0 to genuine completion on real RTL via Animas, using the case_0_1 firmware config (CASE_START=0 CASE_COUNT=1) and a generous +MAXCYCLES=20000000 bound
command: mcp__animas__run_simulation(project_id=9c52d0cd-fe6e-4d80-84cb-ab38f3374f6f) with sim_cflags=[+MEMFILE=build/firmware/configs/case_0_1/firmware.hex, +MAXCYCLES=20000000, +TRACE=0, +RUNID=case0_attempt_001, +HEARTBEAT=500000, +define+RAM_LITE (did not take effect -- ran under ram_model, not ram_model_lite)]
limitations: The run_simulation MCP tool call itself timed out at the harness's 300s idle limit (no response), while the simulation continued correctly server-side -- confirmed via animas.log and /proc/<pid>/stat, then tracked via a background Monitor polling the log file directly rather than another Animas tool call. +define+RAM_LITE did not take effect for this run (SIM_BANNER showed ram=full); correctness unaffected.

purpose: Final, complete, from-cycle-0, 20-case RTL-vs-native comparison run, superseding all earlier partial/stalled attempts (0/20, 7/20, 8/20 historical states). Launched after fixing the waveform-generation (ISS-007/ISS-009) and checker exit-code (ISS-008) problems found during finalization.
command: standalone: flatpak run --branch=1.0.2 --command=zenith com.mifraltech.animaseda <portal-path>/rtl/rv32im_pkg.sv <portal-path>/rtl/rv32im_alu.sv <portal-path>/rtl/rv32im_regfile.sv <portal-path>/rtl/rv32im_muldiv.sv <portal-path>/rtl/rv32im_core.sv <portal-path>/rtl/mmio.sv <portal-path>/rtl/soc_top.sv <portal-path>/tb/ram_model.sv <portal-path>/tb/ram_model_lite.sv <portal-path>/tb/soc_tb.sv -top soc_tb +define+RAM_LITE +MEMFILE=<portal-path>/build/firmware/configs/case_full/firmware.hex +MAXCYCLES=250000000 +TRACE=0 +RUNID=full20_final_001 +HEARTBEAT=500000 (no --zwdb; bypasses Animas MCP daemon entirely)

measured_results.classifier_accuracy_on_fixed_cases: 16/20 (misclassified case_id 0, 11, 15, 16 -- pre-existing model quality limitation, reproduced exactly by RTL)

limitations: None observed in this run itself: no error halts, no timeouts, monotonic cycles, single correctly-ordered final status, full provenance match (model sha256, firmware ELF sha256, SIM_BANNER configuration). The model's own quantized test macro-F1 (0.7709, below the 0.85 target) is a separate, pre-existing, unchanged result.
